en.summary: Content versions change without replacing the active SW; Chromium
details: dir             Published site directory; default: public
--headed        Show the browser window
--trace         Save trace.zip; default output: system temporary directory
--out <dir>     Save JSON and screenshot in a new subdirectory
--timeout <ms>  Browser launch and individual action timeout; default: 15000
--next <dir>    Next build; same SW and different content version
--page <path>   Build version panel; default: /powered-by/
--from <path>   Second cached page; default: /
swban check/browser/pwa/content ./old --next ./new
swban check/browser/pwa/content ./old --next ./new --trace --out ./browser-report

zh.summary: 切换内容版本，保留活动 SW；Chromium
details: dir             已完成的站点构建目录；默认：public
--headed        显示浏览器窗口
--trace         保存 trace.zip；默认输出到系统临时目录
--out <dir>     在新子目录保存 JSON 和截图
--timeout <ms>  浏览器启动和单次操作的超时，单位为毫秒；默认：15000
--next <dir>    下一份构建，SW 相同而内容版本不同
--page <path>   构建版本面板；默认：/powered-by/
--from <path>   第二个缓存页面；默认：/
swban check/browser/pwa/content ./old --next ./new
swban check/browser/pwa/content ./old --next ./new --trace --out ./browser-report
